title: str2num
summary: Convert text containing numeric matrix literals to a numeric array.

gpu_support.notes: Evaluation is host-only. Integer, numeric, and provider-resident inputs are not text and reject before provider access.

fusion.notes: Not eligible for fusion; this builtin materializes host text or logical results.

description: `str2num(text)` parses a scalar string or character array as a numeric matrix expression. It is a text parser, not a numeric conversion function; use `string` to turn numeric data into text and `str2double` for element-wise text parsing.
behaviors: Convert text containing numeric matrix literals to a numeric array.
Parses bracketed numeric matrix text with whitespace, comma, and semicolon separators.
When a second output is requested, returns a logical success flag instead of throwing for malformed numeric text.
RunMat currently implements numeric matrix literal parsing. The R2026a `Evaluation` option and general expression-evaluation surface remain implementation gaps.
examples: [x,tf] = str2num("[1 2; 3 4]") returns a 2-by-2 numeric matrix and true.
